After unlocking, the same Load refreshes its permitted shadow and synchronously pushes current tombstones, including incoming Vault(empty), before readiness/reply and the next FIFO job. It does not sweep never-managed inherited fallback keys. TauriVaultStore::push_key ignores the historical value hint and selects the key for the actual current sender. Verified loads retain additive/touched-aware behavior.

Readiness and mutation waits are separate15-second bounds; renderer services retain one value-free watch, two-second default polling, three-minute cap, refresh/signal behavior and existing permission boundary.
